run.userPrompt:
In 2026, a mobile-game publisher operates one global title with regional monetization variants. Loot-box restrictions now bind in Belgium and the Netherlands, probability disclosure is mandatory in Korea and China, and cultural attitudes toward pay-to-win mechanics, gift-giving events, and cosmetic spending differ across Japan, the Gulf, Brazil, and the US. Player-protection advocacy groups coordinate across borders.

Propose a monetization and product-governance strategy that keeps one global game profitable under divergent loot-box regulations and culturally different spending norms, without fragmenting the player experience irreparably.
